title: How fast? A 30-second, 5-scene lip-synced music video:
content:
How fast? A 30-second, 5-scene lip-synced music video:

• RTX PRO 6000: 6.4 min
• RTX 3080 Ti: 9.7 min
• RTX 3060 12GB / RTX 4060 8GB: ~21 min

Even an RTX 3050 6GB makes one at 512×288 in ~19 min.

title: Someone asked Claude Code to audit their app.
content:
Someone asked Claude Code to audit their app.

It started 708 agents on its own. Three Opus checkers per finding. No cost estimate, no confirmation, no cap.

9 hours in, 45% of their weekly limit was gone. They killed it at 549 agents. No final report.

My rule: before helpers start, show me how many.

title: 谷歌大善人又给我们发福利了：
content:
谷歌大善人又给我们发福利了：

1/ 开源了 Gemini-API Cli: 经常抱怨为啥不能用 Gemini 订阅账户生图生视频，现在开放接口了

2/ 免费 10美刀 API： Gemini-API Cli 只允许用 API, 于是谷歌给了每位开发者 10美刀/月的额度，AI Studio 申请下就能领

在 Antigravity 测试了一句话的“降龙十八掌”，视频凑合看，主要是 Gemini-API Cli 能在 Antigravity 中被调用，agy 如今也能画图，生视频了
